newsitem.title: UK: LPC - Dresdner launches 1.65 bln mark AMD credit.
newsitem.headline: LPC - Dresdner launches 1.65 bln mark AMD credit.

text.p: LONDON, Sept 26 (LPC) - Dresdner Bank is in the early stages of syndicating a 1.65 billion mark credit supporting the development of a semi-conductor plant in Dresden by Advanced Micro Devices, bankers say.

The credit has a five-year tenor. Pricing is still subject to change but should range between 50 bps and 100 bps over LIBOR, according to a banker. The credit will be 65 percent guaranteed by Germany and the State of Saxony, the rest is project risk.
A Dresdner Bank official declined to comment.
The proposed plant will cost 2.8 billion marks in total and will receive funds from German federal and local authorities and the European Union.
Advanced Micro Devices has a long term debt rating of BB minus from Standard & Poor's.
